_comment: "Clash with the attacking hero. THE WINNER creates a Toughness token. You may put YOUR REVEALED CARD on the bottom of its owner's deck." Both payoffs went to the wrong place. The token was a bare CREATE_TOKEN after the clash, so the controller got it whoever won -- including when they lost -- which is the opposite of a clash card. And "your revealed card" was PUT_HAND_CARD_BOTTOM target:"revealed": the wrong zone (a card from HAND, not the clash reveal), the wrong card, and 'target' is not a parameter it reads anyway. CLASH now names the two revealed cards as refs; the alternative already there, reveal_dest:"bottom", bottoms BOTH of them unconditionally, which is neither "yours" nor "you may".
